inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average count from the H1 FY2026 interim EPS note (2,109.255m issued at 28 Feb 2026 less 20.727m treasury shares and 33.711m unvested shares held for the award scheme, plus 9.8m vested awards, 4.2m option dilution). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement: equity-settled share award scheme expenses + equity-settled share option scheme expenses (RMB25.5m); no cash taxes on equity awards disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNYHKD=X 1.1726 from Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-16. fx_rate is model->quote (1 CNY = 1.1726 HKD). No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: the 2025 awarded-share subscription price in the interim is stated as RMB1.60 = ~HK$1.75 (1.094, Sept-2025 rate), consistent direction. All per-share values computed in CNY then multiplied by fx_rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are in HKD, comparable to current_price.
inputs.net_debt_note: 28 Feb 2026 interim: interest-bearing bank loans 878.138 current + 1,657.700 non-current = 2,535.838; lease liabilities 46.453 + 266.491 = 312.944 (treatment A, leases as debt); total_debt 2,848.782. Cash 449.264 + time deposits 9.482 = 458.746 (restricted deposits 0.212 excluded). Net debt 2,390.036. The interest-free net related-party payable (601.773) and the post-balance-sheet Tianlai consideration are carried in equity_bridge, not in net_debt, so that sanity-check multiples use the statutory debt figure.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency. Cost of equity 13.0% = CGB 10y 1.8% + 1.3 beta x 6.5% China ERP + 2.75% small-cap/illiquidity premium (HK-listed micro-cap, 45% founder-held, thin float). Pre-tax cost of debt 3.5% (interim note 15: RMB bank loans at 2.6-6.66%, mostly 3.2-4.4%), 2.7% after 23% tax. Target structure 35% debt / 65% equity (book D/(D+E) ~46%, market-value weights are distorted by the collapsed share price). WACC = 0.65 x 13.0 + 0.35 x 2.7 = 9.4%, rounded to 9.5%. Cross-check: management's own VIU test on the school CGUs uses 17.0-17.4% pre-tax (interim note 8(c)), ~13% post-tax, which brackets the cost of equity. Regulatory/VIE/governance risk is charged ONCE, in the bear scenario and its 40% weight, not as a further WACC premium; WACC is identical across scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: A: leases as debt. Lease liabilities (312.9) are in total_debt; lease principal (21.6) and lease interest (12.4) are NOT deducted from the flows; D&A includes right-of-use depreciation; capex_pct_path carries ~1pp for lease-asset renewal. Leases are small (~1% of revenue) because most ROU assets are purchased PRC land-use rights, which already flow through investing capex.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is in deficit (-14.086 at 28 Feb 2026; attributable profit 664.3 exceeds total 648.1 in FY2025). Flows modelled at 100%; the NCI deficit is added back once in equity_bridge (+14.086). Tianlai (51%) will add a 49% NCI from FY2027 but on a ~RMB245m business it is immaterial at this stage.
inputs.normalization_note: FY0 EBITDA margin is UNDERLYING, not reported: FY2025 reported EBITDA 1,258.6 (35.1%) includes the RMB100.0m one-off reversal of 2021 PP&E impairments (art-training licences) less an RMB8.8m goodwill impairment; underlying pre-SBC EBITDA = 1,258.6 - 100.0 + 8.8 + 25.5 SBC = 1,192.9 = 33.2% of revenue. H1 FY2026 reported EBITDA 810.2 includes a further RMB81.9m reversal; underlying 728.3 = 34.0% vs 37.4% in H1 FY2025 (gross margin -2.4pp), so underlying EBITDA grew ~4% on revenue +14%. Year-1 margin is set at 32.0% pre-SBC to reflect that compression. Reported FCF needs no reversal adjustment (the reversals are non-cash), but FY2025 owner FCF of 423.4 (11.8%) is above the component-built year-1 figure because FY2026 capex is front-loaded (H1 FY2026 capex 540.2, of which land-use rights 452.4).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: non-US operating company; adaptations file read for CNY/HKD currency split, IFRS-16 leases, NCI, and charge-risk-once). Not a bank/REIT/LIC. Fresh build, no prior DCF. ANCHOR WARNING: the share price has fallen ~75% from HK$2.8 (Jan-Feb 2026, when the chairman was buying at HK$2.6-2.8) to the price at inputs.price_as_of in a continuous nine-month slide on heavy volume (April, June and September 2026 legs). The latest filing in hand is the H1 FY2026 interim (period to 28 Feb 2026) and nothing in it explains the move; the market is pricing something this model cannot see (regulatory perimeter, related-party/governance, share-pledge selling, or refinancing). That is handled by a severe bear case at 40% weight, not by a WACC premium. Buybacks: the company is a repurchaser (RMB38.8m FY2025, RMB51.2m H1 FY2026 incl. treasury), so the flat count is funded. Interest income (RMB2.9m FY2025) left in the flows: the company is net-debt, not net-cash. Price is the HKEX regular close, not an after-hours print. Guidance: none quantitative; enrolment ~60,000 at Autumn 2025 intake (+11% YoY) is the year-1 volume anchor; H1 FY2026 revenue +14.2%.

equity_bridge.item: Net amounts due to related parties (interest-free, payable 1-3 yrs, incl. amounts due to the deconsolidated Affected Business)
equity_bridge.note: 28 Feb 2026: due to related parties 896.328 current + 578.780 non-current, less due from related parties 873.335 (interim note 20(b)). Debt-like financing from chairman-affiliated entities; repaid through financing activities.

equity_bridge.item: Tianlai Technology Group 51% acquisition, cash consideration not yet paid at balance-sheet date
equity_bridge.note: June 2026 agreement: RMB104m secondary purchase + RMB140.8m capital injection = RMB244.8m, less RMB20.0m prepayment already out of cash at 28 Feb 2026 (interim cash flow: prepayments for acquisition of subsidiaries).
Interim balance sheet: NCI (14,086) RMB'000. Flows modelled at 100%; NCI charged once here.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 5-year average of the revenue path (12/9/7/6/5), anchored on the +11% Autumn 2025 enrolment intake and H1 FY2026 revenue +14.2%, decelerating for PRC demographics
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Historical CAGRs are not usable as a forward anchor: FY2021 was an 8-month stub (year-end moved from December to August) in which ~30 compulsory-education schools were deconsolidated with a RMB1.09bn impairment, so FY2020 (pre-deconsolidation, 5-yr base) and FY2022 (first full post-deconsolidation year, 3-yr base) are different businesses. Equity 5-yr CAGR is negative for the same reason. Owner FCF was negative in FY2020 and FY2022 (campus-building capex), so FCF CAGRs are undefined; owner FCF FY2023-FY2025 was 348.1 / 378.9 / 423.4.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC): FY2023 348.1, FY2024 378.9, FY2025 423.4, i.e. +10.3% CAGR over two years, versus reported FCF 375.9 / 420.3 / 449.0 (+9.3%). SBC fell as a share of revenue (1.2% -> 0.7%), so owner FCF grew slightly faster than reported, the reverse of the usual pattern. Reported net income growth (+16.5% FY2025, +21% H1 FY2026) overstates underlying growth because of the impairment reversals; underlying EBIT grew ~6% in FY2025 and ~5% in H1 FY2026.

base.growth_rationale: Year 1 (FY2026) 12%: enrolment +11% into Autumn 2025, H1 FY2026 revenue +14.2%, a few months of Tianlai consolidation. Then decelerates to 3% as the high-school-age cohort starts to shrink (births 15-18 years earlier peaked ~2016-17) and growth shifts to lower-revenue entrusted/franchise schools.
base.margin_rationale: Underlying pre-SBC EBITDA margin was 33.2% in FY2025 and 34.0% in seasonally-strong H1 FY2026 (down 3.4pp YoY). 32.0% flat assumes the H1 compression holds and that AI-driven staff-cost savings merely offset tuition-cap and mix pressure; no re-expansion credited.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 capex is front-loaded (H1 540.2 incl. 452.4 land-use rights): 17% of revenue. Glides to 8% as the asset-light entrusted model takes a larger share of growth; terminal capex (8.0%) stays above D&A (7.5%) for a network still adding campuses at 3% growth.
base.tax_rationale: Effective rate 23.0% FY2025, 22.7% H1 FY2026 (25% statutory, some 15%/9%/3% preferential entities). Cash tax paid (127.4) runs below the charge (193.4) via a growing tax payable; the P&L rate is used, which is the conservative choice.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 12x owner FCF binds (Gordon at 9.5%/2.5% would be 14.6x). 12x FCF is ~6.7x terminal EBITDA, inside the 3-7x range HK-listed PRC school operators have traded at since 2021: no re-rating is assumed.

scenario_narratives.base: Private senior-high schools stay outside the 2021 for-profit/VIE prohibition and the still-unissued classification rules do not reach them. Enrolment grows ~11% into FY2026 then slows with the shrinking cohort, with entrusted/franchise schools and the Tianlai art-education stake supplying mid-single-digit growth by FY2030. The H1 FY2026 gross-margin compression (-2.4pp) persists: underlying pre-SBC EBITDA margin holds at 32%, below FY2025's 33.2%, and the impairment reversals are treated as what they are, non-cash one-offs that do not recur. Capex front-loads in FY2026 (land-use rights) then glides to 8% of revenue as growth goes asset-light. Terminal value is capped at 12x owner FCF (~6.7x EBITDA): no sector re-rating. Leverage is refinanced on current terms; the interest-free related-party payable is repaid from flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: Classification rules are issued and explicitly leave senior-high education open to for-profit operation, lifting the overhang. Gaokao outcomes (399 top-50 admissions in 2025) keep premium pricing intact, enrolment compounds at 15%/12%/10%, the AI companion lowers teacher cost per student, and management fees scale on 23+ entrusted schools. Margin rebuilds to 35%, capex falls to 7.5% on the asset-light mix, prepaid tuition gives a 10% working-capital capture on growth, and the terminal multiple is 14x FCF (~7.6x EBITDA). This needs several independent things to go right (regulation, demographics, AI monetisation, governance) and is weighted accordingly.
scenario_narratives.bear: The regulatory perimeter tightens: classification rules or local enforcement cap tuition increases, restrict for-profit conversion or the Structured Contracts for senior-high schools, and enrolment at the affected campuses declines. Revenue falls ~15% over FY2027-FY2029 and underlying margin compresses to 22.5% on fixed campus and teacher costs. Capex cannot fall below ~8.5% without impairing the network. With RMB2.5bn of bank loans, RMB2.3bn of net current liabilities and ~RMB0.6bn owed to related parties, most of the enterprise value belongs to creditors; the terminal multiple is 8x FCF. This scenario is also where the unexplained 75% share-price collapse of 2026 lives: whatever the market has seen, its effect is modelled here.

probability_weighted.band_note: band_position is degenerate: SBC is ~0.6% of revenue so the house/street spread is a few cents per share, and the price sits far below both; read the house and street values directly, not the band.
probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 40% (house default 15%): a single-regulator dependency in a sector where the same regulator already forced a RMB1.1bn write-down and deconsolidation in 2021; a VIE structure; RMB1.7bn of related-party balances with chairman-affiliated entities; persistent net current liabilities; and a nine-month 75% share-price slide on heavy volume that the filings in hand do not explain. Base 45%. Bull 15%: the bull case needs regulatory clarity, demographic resilience, AI monetisation and governance comfort to arrive together.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the underlying cash flows of a leveraged, regulated PRC school operator, normalised for the non-cash impairment reversals that flatter FY2025 and H1 FY2026 earnings, discounted at a CNY WACC, with regulatory, VIE and governance risk charged once through a severe and heavily-weighted bear case rather than through the discount rate. Terminal multiples are capped at or below where the sector has traded since 2021, so no re-rating is assumed. The headline number is dominated by whether the bear case is avoided: the equity is a residual claim behind RMB2.4bn of net debt and RMB0.6bn of related-party funding.
key_risks_to_valuation: PRC private-education classification rules extending the for-profit/VIE prohibition to senior-high schools (the bear case); this is the single largest driver of the spread between scenarios
Unexplained 2026 share-price collapse: the market may be pricing an event (regulatory, governance, share-pledge, refinancing) that post-dates the H1 FY2026 interim and is not in this model
Related-party balances (~RMB1.7bn gross) with chairman-affiliated entities: cash leakage or non-recovery of the RMB873m receivable would reduce equity value by up to RMB0.42/share (HK$0.50)
Refinancing: RMB878m of bank loans fall due within 12 months against RMB459m of cash; net current liabilities of RMB2.3bn
Impairment reversals (RMB100m FY2025, RMB81.9m H1 FY2026) are stripped from the margin base; reported P/E of ~2x overstates underlying earnings by ~15%
Demographics: the PRC high-school-age cohort shrinks from the early 2030s, which is why terminal growth is 2.5% and the cap multiple 12x
Capex intensity: FY2026 land-use-right purchases (RMB452m in H1) show growth is still capital-hungry despite the asset-light narrative
FX: all values converted at CNYHKD 1.1726; refresh_price.py updates the price but not fx_rate
